    The spanning rows of C⁽²⁾ (Lemma B.2 over 𝔽₂) #

    lem:integral-mesh-cokernels is applied in Section 10 to the prime-field model C⁽²⁾. The rows of Proposition 6.1 span the derivative cokernels of k(Γ_A) (residual_cokerSpan); the spanning property passes to the all-one presentation over k by the gauge of Lemma 4.4 (cokerSpan_gauge), and from there to 𝔽₂ by a coefficient retraction k → 𝔽₂ (cokerSpan_descend): applying the retraction to a relation row = ∑ αᵢ rowᵢ + D f over k gives row = ∑ θ(αᵢ) rowᵢ + D(θ f) over 𝔽₂.

    ∃ (R : ScalarMeshCategory.RowSet S.arTranslationQuiver), ScalarMeshCategory.CokerSpan (S.oneC (ZMod 2)) R ∧ ScalarMeshCategory.TwoRows S.arTranslationQuiver R

    The rows of Proposition 6.1 span the derivative cokernels of C⁽²⁾, and are killed by two over every coefficient ring.
